verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts, and input events, plus Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support. Together these give it a real programmatic control surface, but only on macOS. libghostty is a library for building other terminals rather than for driving Ghostty itself, and no OpenAPI or other public API spec exists (the probes returned 404). missing for 10: a cross-platform control API (nothing documented for Linux), an in-depth API reference beyond feature-page mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Ghostty programmatically.
